<!--
A block quotation whose last paragraph begins with an em dash ends with an
attribution (apaquote.lua): set against the quotation's right edge with no
first-line indent, in every format. The attribution keeps its markup and its
citation, which citeproc resolves as it does any other.

The second quotation is a dash and nothing above it, so it is a line of its
own and not an attribution. The third ends with a dash but sits inside a
no-attribution div, which leaves it as written. The fourth has two
paragraphs: in .docx the second takes NextBlockText, as it always has, and
the attribution takes QuoteAttribution rather than that.
-->

Alphaone alphatwo.

> Quoteone words of a quotation long enough that it has to run on to several lines, so that it is a block quotation and not a line of one, quotelast.
>
> --- Attributionone, *Mansfield Park* [-@austenMansfieldPark1990]

Betaone betatwo.

> --- Dashonly words that are a quotation and nothing more.

::: no-attribution
> Dialogueone words of a passage whose last line is spoken.
>
> --- Dialoguetwo says the last speaker.
:::

> Paraone words of the first paragraph of a quotation.
>
> Paratwo words of the second paragraph of a quotation.
>
> --- Attributiontwo
